newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Canada Life aims to build presence in Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Canada Life aims to build presence in Ireland.

text.p: Life assurance group Canada Life (Ireland) said on Tuesday that it plans to build a larger presence in Ireland through both internal growth and acquisition.
The company currently has an estimated seven percent share of the Irish market which puts it in the top five life assurance companies in Ireland.

"Canada Life is looking to capitalise on opportunties which provide synergy in our core businesses of protection, pensions and investment," Don Gallagher, recently appointed managing director of the Irish operation, said in a statement.

To support the company's growth objectives, Kevin Lynch has also been newly appointed to the senior management team as executive director of information technology and administration, the company said.
Gallagher said he believed that a market share of 10 percent was essential to be a life assurance player in the next millennium.
"Any company which is operating below this must consider itself a possible target for acquisition," he said.
